posts.title: Making magic for a new generation, Google Gemini
posts.description: For Google, Gemini is their next leap from turning queries into conversations, succeeding Bard with a promise of a new kind of exploration. Partnering with global design studio Porto Rocha, their goal was to make Gemini the Google Magic for a new generation. A goal that required Google to reclaim the Spark.

posts.title: The timeless way of building {software}
posts.description: There’s a quality in great software that’s hard to name. You feel it in some of the tools you use daily. Products that don’t just work, but seem to know how you want to work. Products that feel inevitable. Architect Christopher Alexander described this feeling in physical buildings, but his words are just as relevant, maybe even more so, in product design.
